title: nan
authors: Dai M.; Li H.; Liang J.; Zhang C.; Pan X.; Tian Y.; Cao J.; Wang Y.
key_contribution: Proposes a lane-level positioning method fusing an inertial dead-reckoning system with HMM-based vector map matching for unmanned driving in GNSS-denied environments, validated to under 30 cm error.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Map_Based_Localization to ensure precise positioning.
